description: Test suite for scheduled post functionalities in Mattermost server, including creation, update, deletion, and WebSocket event publishing.

methods.name: TestSaveScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests for saving scheduled posts, including valid creation, invalid data handling, past scheduling, channel membership, archiving, multiple posts, empty posts, restricted DMs, and burn-on-read posts.

methods.name: TestGetUserTeamScheduledPosts
methods.description: Tests for retrieving scheduled posts for a user within a team, including filtering by team membership, DMs, GMs, and team restrictions.

methods.name: TestUpdateScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests for updating scheduled posts, including field restrictions, permission checks, burn-on-read type preservation, and handling non-existent posts.

methods.name: TestDeleteScheduledPost
methods.description: Tests for deleting scheduled posts, including successful deletion and error handling for non-existent posts.

methods.name: TestPublishScheduledPostEvent
methods.description: Tests for publishing WebSocket events when scheduled posts are created or nil, verifying event data and handling.
